Samantha Ortiz (manager) — very positive. Highlighted: strong code ownership, communicates trade-offs well, took lead on rollout issues in Q4 2020. No performance concerns. Suggested area for growth: broader system-level design.

Dr. Paul Nguyen (advisor) — excellent academic depth, strong problem formulation. Mentioned Eliot's comfort with research adjacent tasks and ability to translate papers to engineering work. No red flags.

Marcus Lee (co-founder) — collaborative, pragmatic; emphasized shipping velocity and product sense. Noted occasional preference for iterative solutions over theoretical purity — framed as speed/impact tradeoff.
